'''Perri-Teeka''' was a legendary<ref name="Inside" /> and revered<ref name="Illustrated">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Illustrated Companion]]''</ref> [[Gender/Legends|statesman]] associated with the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Inside" /> The [[Hall of Perri-Teeka/Legends|Hall of Perri-Teeka]], located in Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], was an<ref name="Inside" /> impressive<ref name="Illustrated" /> monument to the man constructed at some point<ref name="Inside" /> by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Year">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}}, as depicted in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Perri-Teeka was first mentioned in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', a [[2000]] reference book written by [[Kristin Lund]].<ref name="Inside" />
